title: Image Analyzer: use Computer Vision v3.2 instead of retiring v1.0
summary: The Image Analyzer app switches from the retiring Computer Vision v1.0 to v3.2 API to prevent failures after the v1.0 retirement date of September 2026.
key_points: Addresses Azure Computer Vision v1.0 API retirement scheduled for 2026-09-13
Switches to already-shipped v3.2 provider with same OAuth2 authentication and response structure
No functional changes since the app only reads image tags which remain compatible
Mirrors existing implementation in ItemFromPicture codeunit
Low risk change that removes near-term API retirement exposure
quote: Azure Computer Vision v1.0 Analyze API is retired on 2026-09-13.
